drafter.private_reasoning: The client’s side and settlement amount are not specified. Keep the release tied to the settled claims, add workable confidentiality exceptions, and request the missing payment terms without disclosing confidential client information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is a revised draft with a release tied to the settled claims and customary confidentiality exceptions. Please confirm the settlement amount, payment deadline, and payment method so we can complete the payment provision.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount agreed by the parties (the “Settlement Amount”) by the agreed payment deadline, using the payment method and instructions confirmed in writing by Plaintiff.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the dispute resolved by this Agreement, whether known or unknown as of the date of this Agreement. This release does not affect either party’s rights or obligations under this Agreement.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law or court order, or made to their attorneys, accountants, insurers, or other professional advisers who are informed of its confidential nature. A party required to disclose the terms shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice.
edits.name: Confidentiality
